description: Is this paid endpoint answering right now? Returns whether it serves a payment challenge, how many well-formed priced offers it carries, which warnings would actually break a payment as opposed to merely making the call harder to construct, and a single payable_now flag. Reports only what was observed; it makes no judgement about the seller. Pay 4000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

body.description: Optional JSON body to send with a POST probe.

method.description: Method to probe with. Defaults to GET.

url.description: HTTPS URL of an x402 endpoint on a reviewed origin. Credentials, ports and fragments are refused.

name: x402_endpoint_health

blocking_warnings.description: The subset that would break a payment, rather than merely make the request harder to construct.

challenge.description: The decoded payment challenge, or null when the endpoint served none.

challenge_source.description: header or body, depending on where the endpoint put the challenge.

payable_now.description: A challenge is served, at least one priced offer is well formed, and nothing blocking is wrong.

payment_sent.description: Always false. This service never pays the endpoint it probes.

priced_offers.description: Offers with an exact scheme, an amount, a network and a payTo.

request_constructible.description: The endpoint declares an input schema, so a client can be built without guessing.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: x402 Endpoint Health
